name: @kiwa-test/security-devsecops
description: DevSecOps test harness for kiwa v0.1 — 6 axis (SAST + SCA + Secret scan + IaC scan + DAST + Container security) unified across 4 provider (Semgrep + Trivy + Gitleaks + tfsec + OWASP ZAP + Grype) with a 4x6 = 24 combination fidelity harness, KIWA_MODE=real env-gate, and quality-metrics 15-axis release gate integration. Complements v0.2 @kiwa-test/security (advanced runtime security: CSP + mTLS + SIEM + SLSA) with build-time / CI-time security scanning axis.

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
